title: Discovery: from gaps to rules
context: Condensed from the healthcare client's repo: docs/discovery (22 Sep), docs/decisions and AGENTS.md. Questions and answers are quoted from those files, shortened; identifiers removed.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Daily dashboard combining commerce, Google Ads and GA4. Discovery and clarification before implementation.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Discovery first
compact.summary: Daily dashboard combining commerce, Google Ads and GA4. Discovery and clarification before implementation.

messages.name: BigQuery · Sheets · Git
messages.text: Read-only inspection: schemas, bounded aggregates, scheduler metadata, failure logs.

compact.label: Discovery
compact.title: What was checked
items: GA4 export: 231 daily tables
Ads reporting mart: 8,533 campaign/day rows
Legacy workbook: 12 tabs
8 reference repos, read-only

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Discovery establishes viable sources but does not certify full historical completeness.

compact.title: 9 gaps and risks
compact.summary: Found before any code was written.
items: Shopify authorization broken (HTTP 401)
Order extraction omits country
Ads geography misses Performance Max
Missing prior-year periods must show unavailable, not zero

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: These are definition/access questions, not a request to approve unfinished implementation.

compact.title: 8 decisions for a human
items: Revenue contract: net merchandise or order total? VAT, shipping, refunds by order or refund date?
Migration boundary: the authoritative Woo → Shopify cutover date?
Country rule: shipping → billing → Unknown for commerce; user location for Ads?
Access: which Google accounts may see the report?

tooltip.title: The agent stops and asks
tooltip.body: Business definitions are not guessed. They go to a human.

messages.name: Decisions
messages.text: Both net merchandise revenue and order total. Shopify from 29 April 2026. Payment received only, no test orders. Refunds on the original order date. Google-account allowlist.

compact.label: Decisions
compact.title: The answers
compact.summary: Recorded in docs/decisions.md on the same day.
items: Both net merchandise revenue and order total
Shopify from 29 April 2026
Paid orders only, no test orders
Refunds belong to the original order date

messages.name: Git
messages.text: The answers became rules in AGENTS.md and CONTRACTS.md.

compact.label: Semantic library
compact.title: Rules the agent reads before every task
items: Never add Shopify revenue to Google Ads or GA4 attributed revenue
Resolve campaigns by account and campaign ID, not names
Missing data is not zero
Report freshness and coverage explicitly

steps.caption: The agent checks the sources, read-only.
It reports the gaps it found.
And stops with questions only a human can answer.
They become the client's semantic library.
